Findings marked verified-present/verified-absent were decided against the installed QNX SDP 8.0 (build 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L) by header, symbol and qcc compile/link probes; nothing was run on a QNX target. All other findings keep their known/guess label: 'guess' is an unverified claim about QNX 8.0.

findings.title: Includes a Linux kernel header
findings.message: <linux/...> and <asm/...> are Linux kernel uapi headers. The QNX SDP 8.0 (build 141) ships no linux/, asm/ or asm-generic/ directory: every such include fails to compile (checked for 21 common ones with qcc on x86_64 and aarch64le). Many uses are trivial (linux/limits.h, linux/types.h can be replaced by POSIX headers); device-ioctl headers are not. [verified on SDP 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L by compile/link probe, not run on target: <linux/types.h> not found / does not compile with qcc on x86_64 and aarch64le]
findings.remedy: Replace each use with the POSIX/QNX equivalent of what the header supplied (types, constants). If it is a device ioctl header, the device needs a QNX resource-manager interface (devctl) instead.
findings.verify: checked against the installed SDP (header, symbol and qcc probes); not executed on a QNX target.

findings.title: CPU affinity (sched_setaffinity & friends)
findings.message: Linux affinity API. On SDP 8.0 build 141 sched_setaffinity, sched_getaffinity, pthread_setaffinity_np, pthread_getaffinity_np, pthread_attr_setaffinity_np, cpu_set_t and the CPU_* macros are all missing (the CPU_* set macros exist only in the io-sock driver headers). [verified on SDP 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L by compile/link probe, not run on target: CPU_ZERO: found only in io-sock kernel/driver headers (devs/), not in any user-facing header; compile probe fails]
findings.remedy: Use ThreadCtl(_NTO_TCTL_RUNMASK, &mask) for the calling thread (ThreadCtl and _NTO_TCTL_RUNMASK are present in SDP 8.0 build 141; the argument layout and the privilege needed were not tested). Semantics are narrower: Linux sched_setaffinity(pid, ...) can target another process or thread, the runmask call applies to the calling thread, so per-pid callers need restructuring.
findings.verify: checked against the installed SDP (header, symbol and qcc probes); not executed on a QNX target.

findings.title: Includes a Linux-specific <sys/...> header
findings.message: This glibc/Linux <sys/...> header is not in the QNX 8.0 SDP for most of the names this rule matches (sys/epoll.h, eventfd.h, signalfd.h, timerfd.h, prctl.h, sendfile.h, sysinfo.h, fanotify.h do not exist in build 141). Two exceptions are present: <sys/inotify.h> (needs -lfsnotify) and <sys/auxv.h> (exists, but getauxval is not declared). findings.title: sendfile/splice zero-copy calls
findings.message: Linux zero-copy file transfer calls. On SDP 8.0 build 141: splice, tee, vmsplice, copy_file_range and sendfile64 are not declared. sendfile() is declared in <sys/socket.h> with the BSD signature (7 arguments) but no SDP library exports it: linking fails (also with -lsocket). A same-named Linux call would not have compiled against that prototype anyway. [verified on SDP 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L by compile/link probe, not run on target: sendfile: declared (sys/socket.h:816 decl) but link fails with the default libraries, -lsocket and -lm: no SDP library exports it]
findings.remedy: Fall back to a read()/write() loop (or mmap + write) behind a small helper; add a platform fast path only if profiling demands it.
findings.verify: checked against the installed SDP (header, symbol and qcc probes); not executed on a QNX target.

findings.title: Linux-specific socket options
findings.message: Socket options that originated on Linux. On SDP 8.0 build 141: TCP_FASTOPEN, TCP_INFO, TCP_NODELAY, TCP_KEEPIDLE/INTVL/CNT, SO_REUSEPORT are defined; TCP_CORK, TCP_QUICKACK, TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT, TCP_USER_TIMEOUT, MSG_MORE, SO_BINDTODEVICE, SO_PRIORITY, SO_MARK, IP_PKTINFO-style Linux options are not. [verified on SDP 8.0.0.00141T202311271501L by compile/link probe, not run on target: TCP_USER_TIMEOUT: not declared in any user header of the SDP and not exported by any SDP library; probe: #error TCP_USER_TIMEOUT not defined]
findings.remedy: Guard each setsockopt/getsockopt with #ifdef so it compiles away when the macro is undefined. Where the macro IS defined (TCP_INFO, TCP_FASTOPEN, SO_REUSEPORT) the struct layout and semantics are BSD's and were not tested: confirm before relying on a same-named constant.
findings.verify: checked against the installed SDP (header, symbol and qcc probes); not executed on a QNX target.

rules.title: Includes a Linux kernel header
rules.remedy: Replace each use with the POSIX/QNX equivalent of what the header supplied (types, constants). If it is a device ioctl header, the device needs a QNX resource-manager interface (devctl) instead.
rules.verify: Checked on SDP 8.0 build 141: no linux/ or asm/ include directory exists. Other SDP versions: verify against SDP.
rules.message: <linux/...> and <asm/...> are Linux kernel uapi headers. The QNX SDP 8.0 (build 141) ships no linux/, asm/ or asm-generic/ directory: every such include fails to compile (checked for 21 common ones with qcc on x86_64 and aarch64le). Many uses are trivial (linux/limits.h, linux/types.h can be replaced by POSIX headers); device-ioctl headers are not.

Two exceptions are present: <sys/inotify.h> (needs -lfsnotify) and <sys/auxv.h> (exists, but getauxval is not declared).

On SDP 8.0 build 141: splice, tee, vmsplice, copy_file_range and sendfile64 are not declared. sendfile() is declared in <sys/socket.h> with the BSD signature (7 arguments) but no SDP library exports it: linking fails (also with -lsocket). rules.title: CPU affinity (sched_setaffinity & friends)
rules.remedy: Use ThreadCtl(_NTO_TCTL_RUNMASK, &mask) for the calling thread (ThreadCtl and _NTO_TCTL_RUNMASK are present in SDP 8.0 build 141; the argument layout and the privilege needed were not tested). Semantics are narrower: Linux sched_setaffinity(pid, ...) can target another process or thread, the runmask call applies to the calling thread, so per-pid callers need restructuring.
rules.verify: Absence verified on SDP 8.0 build 141; ThreadCtl usage not run.
rules.message: Linux affinity API. On SDP 8.0 build 141 sched_setaffinity, sched_getaffinity, pthread_setaffinity_np, pthread_getaffinity_np, pthread_attr_setaffinity_np, cpu_set_t and the CPU_* macros are all missing (the CPU_* set macros exist only in the io-sock driver headers).
